newsitem.title: INDIA: Eight injured in Kashmir protest over Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Eight injured in Kashmir protest over Hebron.

text.p: At least six women demonstrators and two policemen were injured in Kashmir on Friday as police clashed with Moslem women protesting against a blasphemy against Islam at Hebron, police and witnesses said.
In Srinagar, the summer capital of India's mostly Moslem Jammu and Kashmir state, police used tear gas and batons to control hundreds of women who took to the streets against last month's incident.

A Jewish woman faces up to 26 years in prison for putting up posters in Hebron portraying the Prophet Mohammad as a pig. The posters sparked a wave of unrest in the city where 400 Jews live amid 100,000 Arabs.
The women demonstrators in Srinagar carried placards that said: "We cannot tolerate blasphemy of Prophet Mohammad."
Moslem separatists are fighting Indian rule since 1990 in Kashmir.
